name: story-relevance-validation-tiers-plan
title: Define the Story-relevance dynamic validation tiers execution plan
description: Create a canonical execution plan for dynamically selecting Story-relevant fast and intermediate validation while retaining repository-full validation as the exhaustive safety boundary. The plan must define selection inputs, impact indexing, signed selection evidence, fail-closed escalation, CLI behavior, rollout stages, and measurable acceptance without implementing runtime changes.
